raw_Chinese: 1.承运人只有在依据和托运人达成的协议或该特定的贸易习惯，或为法规或规则所要求时，才有权在舱面载运货物。

raw_Chinese: 1.除非收货人已在不迟于货物向其交付的下一工作日，将载明灭失或损坏的一般性质的灭失或损坏的通知书面送交承运人，这种交接便是承运人已按运输单证所载交付货物，或者，在未签发此种单证时，以良好状态交付货物的初步证据。
raw_English: Unless notice of loss or damage , specifying the general nature of such loss or damage , is given in writing by the consignee to the carrier not later than the working day after the day when the goods were handed over to the consignee , such handing over is prima facie evidence of the delivery by the carrier of the goods as described in the document of transport or , if no such document has been issued , in good condition .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.如果灭失或损坏不明显，则如在货物交付收货人之日以后连续十五日内未曾送交书面通知，本条第1款的规定应相应地适用。
raw_English: Where the loss or damage is not apparent , the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article apply correspondingly if notice in writing is not given within 15 consecutive days after the day when the goods were handed over to the consignee .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 3.如果货物的状况在其被交付收货人之时已经当事各方联合检验或检查，便无需就检验或检查时查明的灭失和损坏，送交书面通知。
raw_English: If the state of the goods at the time they were handed over to the consignee has been the subject of a joint surveyor inspection by the parties , notice in writing need not be given of loss or damage ascertained during such surveyor inspection .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 4.遇有任何实际的或预料发生的灭失或损坏时，承运人和收货人须为检验和清点货物相互提供一切合理的便利。
raw_English: In the case of any actual or apprehended loss or damage , the carrier and the consignee must give all reasonable facilities to each other for inspecting and tallying the goods .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 5.除非在货物交付给收货人之日以后连续六十天之内，已将书面通知送交承运人，对因延迟交付所造成的损失，不予以赔偿。
raw_English: No compensation shall be payable for loss resulting from delay in delivery unless a notice has been given in writing to the carrier within 60 consecutive days after the day when the goods were handed over to the consignee .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 6.如果货物已由实际承运人交付，则根据本条规定送交的任何通知，具有如同送交承运人的通知的同等效力；而送交承运人的任何通知，具有如同送交实际承运人的通知的同等效力。
raw_English: If the goods have been delivered by an actual carrier , any notice given under this article to him shall have the same effect as if it had been given to the carrier , and any notice given to the carrier shall have effect as if given to such actual carrier .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 7.除非承运人或实际承运人已在不迟于灭失或损坏发生之后，或依照第4条第2款在货物交付之后（以较迟者为准）连续九十天之内，将载明灭失或损坏的一般性质的灭失或损坏通知，书面送交托运人，否则，未送交此种通知便是承运人或实际承运人并未由于托运人、其受雇人或代理人的过失或疏忽而遭受灭失或损坏的初步证据。
raw_English: Unless notice of loss or damage , specifying the general nature of the loss or damage , is given in writing by the carrier or actual carrier to the shipper not later than 90 consecutive days after the occurrence of such loss or damage or after the delivery of the goods in accordance with paragraph 2 of article 4 , whichever is later , the failure to give such notice is prima facie evidence that the carrier or the actual carrier has sustained no loss or damage due to the fault or neglect of the shipper , his servants or agents .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 8.就本条而言，将通知送交代表承运人或实际承运人行事的人，或已送交代表托运人行事的人，视为已经分别送交承运人、实际承运人或托运人。
raw_English: For the purpose of this article , notice given to a person acting on the carrier 's or the actual carrier 's behalf , including the master or the officer in charge of the ship , or to a person acting on the shipper 's behalf is deemed to have been given to the carrier , to the actual carrier or to the shipper , respectively .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.如果在两年之内未提起法律诉讼或仲裁，根据本公约的有关货物运输的任何诉讼，即失去时效。
raw_English: Any action relating to carriage of goods under this Convention is time-barred if judicial or arbitral proceedings have not been instituted within a period of two years .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.时效期限自承运人交付货物或交付部分货物之日，或者，在未交付货物时，则自应交付货物的最后一日起算。
raw_English: The limitation period commences on the day on which the carrier has delivered the goods or part thereof or , in cases where no goods have been delivered , on the last day on which the goods should have been delivered .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 3.时效期限起算的当日，不包括在期限之内。
raw_English: The day on which the limitation period commences is not included in the period .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 4.被要求赔偿的人，可在时效期限之内的任何时间向索赔人提出书面声明，延长时效期限。
raw_English: The person against whom a claim is made may at any time during the running of the limitation period extend that period by a declaration in writing to the claimant .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 该期限可以通过再次声明而进一步延长。
raw_English: This period may be further extended by another declaration or declarations .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 5.负有赔偿责任的人提起的追偿诉讼，如果是在诉讼所在国法律所许可的时间之内提起，即使是在上述各款规定的时效期限届满之后，亦可提起。
raw_English: An action for indemnity by a person held liable may be instituted even after the expiration of the limitation period provided for in the preceding paragraphs if instituted within the time allowed by the law of the State where proceedings are instituted .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 但是，所许可的时间，自提起此种诉讼的人已经解决索赔，或已接到向其本人送交的起诉传票之日起算，不得少于九十天。
raw_English: However , the time allowed shall not be less than 90 days commencing from the day when the person instituting such action for indemnity has settled the claim or has been served with process in the action against himself .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.在根据本公约的有关货物运输的法律诉讼中，原告可以根据法院所在国家的法律，自行选定在有权进行管辖，而且是在其管辖范围之内的下列地点之一的法院提起诉讼。
raw_English: In judicial proceedings relating to carriage of goods under this Convention the plaintiff , at his option , may institute an action in a court which according to the law of the State where the court is situated , is competent and within the jurisdiction of which is situated one of the following places :
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （d）海上运输合同中为此目的而指定的任何其他地点。
raw_English: [ d ] any additional place designated for that purpose in the contract of carriage by sea .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.（a）虽有本条前述规定，如果载货船舶或属于同一船舶所有人的任何其他船舶，在某一缔约国的任何港口或地点依照该国的法律或国际法中适用的规则被扣押，诉讼便可向该港口或一地点所在法院提起。
raw_English: [ a ] Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this article , an action may be instituted in the courts of any port or place in a Contracting State at which the carrying vessel or any other vessel of the same ownership may have been arrested in accordance with applicable rules of the law of that State and of international law .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 但是，在这种情况下，经被告请求，索赔人须将诉讼转移至其在本条第1款规定的有管辖权的某一法院，以解决索赔。但在诉讼转移之前，被告必须提供充分的担保，以偿付日后可能判归索赔人的赔偿金额。
raw_English: However , in such a case , at the petition of the defendant , the claimant must remove the action , at his choice , to one of the jurisdictions referred to in paragraph 1 of this article for the determination of the claim , but before such removal the defendant must furnish security sufficient to ensure payment of any judgement that may subsequently be awarded to the claimant in the action .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （b）一切有关担保是否充分等问题，应由扣船港口或地点的法院确定。
raw_English: [ b ] All questions relating to the sufficiency or otherwise of the security shall be determined by the court of the port or place of the arrest .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 3.根据本公约而提起的有关货物运输的任何法律诉讼，不得在本条第1或2款未规定的地点提出。
raw_English: No judicial proceedings relating to carriage of goods under this Convention may be instituted in a place not specified in paragraph 1 or 2 of this article .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 本款上述规定并不构成对缔约国采取临时性或保护性措施的管辖权的妨碍。
raw_English: The provisions of this paragraph do not constitute an obstacle to the jurisdiction of the Contracting States for provisional or protective measures .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 4.（a）如已向根据本条第1款或第2款有管辖权的法院提起诉公，或已由此种法院作出判决，则除非受理第一次诉讼的法院的判决不能在提起新的诉讼的国家执行，相同当事人之间不得以同样理由提起新的诉讼。
raw_English: [ a ] Where an action has been instituted in a court competent under paragraph 1 or 2 of this article or where judgement has been delivered by such a court , no new action may be started between the same parties on the same grounds unless the judgement of the court before which the first action was instituted is not enforceable in the country in which the new proceedings are instituted ;
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （b）就本条而言，为了求得判决的执行而采取的措施，不视为提起新的诉讼。
raw_English: [ b ] For the purpose of this article , the institution of measures with a view to obtaining enforcement of a judgement is not to be considered as the starting of a new action ;
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （c）就本条而言，诉讼转移至同一国家的另一法院，或者依照本条第2款侮（a）项转移至另一国家的法院，不视为提起新的诉讼。
raw_English: [ c ] For the purpose of this article , the removal of an action to a different court within the same country , or to a court in another country , in accordance with paragraph 2 [ a ] of this article , is not to be considered as the starting of a new action .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 5.虽有上述各款规定，在根据海上运输合同提出索赔之后，当事各方达成的关于索赔人可以提起诉讼地点的协议，仍属有效。
raw_English: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraphs , an agreement made by the parties , after a claim under the contract of carriage by sea has arisen , which designates the place where the claimant may institute an action , is effective .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.根据本条规定，当事各方可用以书面证明的协议规定，有关按本公约运输货物所发生的争议，都应提交仲裁。
raw_English: Subject to the provisions of this article , parties may provide by agreement evidenced in writing that any dispute that may arise relating to carriage of goods under this Convention shall be referred to arbitration .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.如果租船合同中载有应将该租船合同所引起的争议提交仲裁的条款，而根据租船合同签发的提单并未载有一项特别注解，规定该条款对提单持有人具有约束力，则承运人不得援用该条款以对抗善意地取得提单的人。
raw_English: Where a charter-party contains a provision that disputes arising thereunder shall be referred to arbitration and a bill of lading issued pursuant to the charter-party does not contain a special annotation providing that such provision shall be binding upon the holder of the bill of lading , the carrier may not invoke . such provision as against a holder having acquired the bill of lading in good faith .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （b）仲裁条款或协议中为此目的而指定的任何地点。
raw_English: [ b ] any place designated for that purpose in the arbitration clause or agreement .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 4.仲裁员或仲裁庭应当适用本公约各项规则。
raw_English: The arbitrator or arbitration tribunal shall apply the rules of this Convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 5.本条第3款、第4款的规定，视为每一仲裁条款或协议的一部分；仲裁条款或协议中凡是与此相抵角的任何规定，概属无效。
raw_English: The provisions of paragraphs 3 and 4 of this article are deemed to be part of every arbitration clause or agreement , and any term of such clause or agreement which is inconsistent therewith is null and void .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 6.本条规定，不影响当事各方在根据海上运输合同产生索赔之后订立的有关仲裁协议的效力。
raw_English: Nothing in this article affects the validity of an agreement relating to arbitration made by the parties after the claim under the contract of carriage by sea has arisen .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.海上运输合同中或提单或作为海上运输合同证明的任何其他单证中的任何条款，在其直接或间接背离本公约规定的范围内，概属无效。
raw_English: Any stipulation in a contract of carriage by sea , in a bill of lading , or in any other document evidencing the contract of carriage by sea is null and void to the extent that it derogates , directly or indirectly , from the provisions of this Convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 此种条款之无效，并不影响以其作为部分内容的该合同或单证的其他规定的效力。
raw_English: The nullity of such a stipulation does not affect the validity of the other provisions of the contract or document of which it forms a part .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 将货物的保险利益转让予承运人的条款，或任何类似条款，概属无效。
raw_English: A clause assigning benefit of insurance of goods in favor of the carrier , or any similar clause , is null and void .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.虽有本条第1款的规定，承运人仍可增加其根据本公约所承担的责任和义务。
raw_English: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article , a carrier may increase his responsibilities and obligations under this Convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 3.在签发提单或作为海上运输合同证明的任何其他单证时，其中必须载有一项声明，说明该运输应受本公约各项规定的约束，凡是与此相背离的有损于托运人或收货人的条款，概属无效。
raw_English: Where a bill of lading or any other document evidencing the contract of carriage by sea is issued , it must contain a statement that the carriage is subject to the provisions of this Convention which nullify any stipulation derogating therefrom to the detriment of the shipper or the consignee .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 4.如果有关货物的索赔人由于根据本条而无效的条款，或由于未载有本条第3款所述声明而遭受损失，则承运人必须按照本公约规定，就货物的灭失或损坏以及延迟交付，在赔偿索赔人所需限度之内，支付赔偿金。
raw_English: Where the claimant in respect of the goods has incurred loss as a result of a stipulation which is null and void by virtue of the present article , or as a result of the omission of the statement referred to in paragraph 3 of this article , the carrier must pay compensation to the extent required in order to give the claimant compensation in accordance with the provisions of this Convention for any loss of or damage to the goods as well as for delay in delivery .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 此外，承运人还须赔偿索赔人为行使其权利而发生的费用。但援用上述规定而发生的诉讼费用，应根据诉讼所在国法律确定。
raw_English: The carrier must , in addition , pay compensation for costs incurred by the claimant for the purpose of exercising his right , provided that costs incurred in the action where the foregoing provision is invoked are to be determined in accordance with the law of the State where proceedings are instituted .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.本公约中的任何规定，不妨碍海上运输合同或国内法中有关共同海损理算的规定的适用。
raw_English: Nothing in this Convention shall prevent the application of provisions in the contract of carriage by sea or national law regarding the adjustment of general average .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.除第20条外，本公约关于承运人对于货物的灭失或损坏的责任的规定，也确定收货人可否拒绝分摊共同海损，以及承运人就收货人所作的任何此项分摊或所付的任何救助费用而给予收货人赔偿的责任。
raw_English: With the exception of article 20 , the provisions of this Convention relating to the liability of the carrier for loss of or damage to the goods also determine whether the consignee may refuse contribution in general average and the liability of the carrier to indemnify the consignee in respect of any such contribution made or any salvage paid .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.本公约并不改变有关海船所有人责任限制的国际公约或国内法中规定的承运人、实际承运人及其受雇人或代理人的权利或义务。
raw_English: This Convention does not modify the rights or duties of the carrier , the actual carrier and their servants and agents provided for in international conventions or national law relating to the limitation of liability of owners of seagoing ships .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.本公约第21条及第21条各项规定，并不妨碍在上述条款所涉及的问题上适用在本公约生效之日已经生效的多边公约的强制性条款，但须以争议完全发生在其主要营业所位于此种其他公约的缔约国之间为条件。
raw_English: The provisions of articles 21 and 22 of this Convention do not prevent the application of the mandatory provisions of any other multilateral convention already in force at the date of this Convention relating to matters dealt with in the said articles , provided that the dispute arises exclusively between parties having their principal place of business in States members of such other convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 但是，本款规定并不影响本公约第22条第4款的适用。
raw_English: However , this paragraph does not affect the application of paragraph 4 of article 22 of this Convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 3.对于核事故引起的损害，如果核装置的经营人员根据下述情况而对此种损害负责，则不应根据本公约规定产生责任。
raw_English: No liability shall arise under the provisions of this Convention for damage caused by a nuclear incident if the operator of a nuclear installation is liable for such damage :
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （b）根据对这种损害的责任加以规定的国内法，如果这种法律在各方面和《巴黎公约》或《维也纳公约》同样有利于可能遭受损害的人。
raw_English: [ b ] by virtue of national law governing the liability for such damage , provided that such law is in all respects as favourable to persons who may suffer damage as is either the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 4.对于按照有关海上运送旅客及其行李的国际公约或国内法，由承运人负责的行李的灭失、损坏或延迟交付，不应根据本公约规定产生责任。
raw_English: No liability shall arise under the provisions of this Convention for any loss of or damage to or delay in delivery of luggage for which the carrier is responsible under any international convention or national law relating to the carriage of passengers and their luggage by sea .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 5.本公约各项规定，并不妨碍缔约国适用任何其他在本公约生效之日已经生效、并且强制适用于其主要运输方式不是海运的货物运输合同的公约。
raw_English: Nothing contained in this Convention prevents a Contracting State from applying any other international convention which is already in force at the date of this Convention and which applies mandatorily to contracts of carriage of goods primarily by a mode of transport other than transport by sea .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 本款规定也适用于随后对此种国际公约的修订或修正。
raw_English: This provision also applies to any subsequent revision or amendment of such international convention .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1.本公约第6条所述计算单位，系国际货币基金组织地规定的特别提款权。
raw_English: The unit of account referred to in article 6 of this Convention is the special drawing right as defined by the International Monetary Fund .

raw_Chinese: 第6条所述金额，应按判决之日或当事人协议之日该国货币价值，折成该国货币。
raw_English: The amounts mentioned in article 6 are to be converted into the national currency of a State according to the value of such currency at the date of judgement or the date agreed upon by the parties .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 凡属国际货币基金组织成员国的本公约缔约国，其以特别提款权表示的本国货币价值，应按国际货币基金组织在述日期进行营业和交易中适用的现行定值办法计算。
raw_English: The value of a national currency , in terms of the special drawing right , of a Contracting State which is a member of the International Monetary Fund is to be calculated in accordance with the method of valuation applied by the International Monetary Fund in effect at the date in question for its operations and transactions .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 非属国际货币基金组织成员国的本公约缔约国，其以特别提款权表示的本国货币价值，应按该国确定的方式计算。
raw_English: The value of a national currency , in terms of the special drawing right , of a Contracting State which is not a member of the International Monetary Fund is to be calculated in a manner determined by that State .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 2.但是，非属国际货币基金组织成员国，且其法律又不允许适用本条第1款规定的国家，可在其签字或批准、接受、认可或加入时，或在其后任何时间提出声明，在其境内将适用的本公约规定的责任限制确定为每件或每一其他装运单位为12500货币单位，或按该货毛重计算，为每公斤37.5货币单位。
raw_English: Nevertheless , those States which are not members of the International Monetary Fund and whose law does not permit the application of the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article may , at the time of signature , or at the time of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession or at any time thereafter , declare that the limits of liability provided for in this Convention to be applied in their territories shall be fixed as 12,500 monetary units per package or other shipping unit or 37.5 monetary units per kilogram of gross weight of the goods .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 3.本条第2款所述货币单位，相当于纯度为千分之九百的黄金65.5毫克。
raw_English: The monetary unit referred to in paragraph 2 of this article corresponds to sixty-five and a half milligrams of gold of millesimal fineness nine hundred .

raw_Chinese: 将第2款所述金额折算为国家货币时，应按该国法律规定进行。
raw_English: The conversion of the amounts referred to in paragraph 2 into the national currency is to be made according to the law of the State concerned .

raw_Chinese: 4.在进行本条第1款最后一句所述的计算，和本条第3款所述的折算时，其方式应使第6条所述金额在以缔约国本国货币表示时，尽可能具有与这一金额以计算单位表示时的相同真实价值。
raw_English: The calculation mentioned in the last sentence of paragraph 1 and the conversion mentioned in paragraph 3 of this article is to be made in such a manner as to express in the national currency of the Contracting State as far as possible the same real value for the amounts in article 6 as is expressed there in units of account .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 缔约国须视情况将按本条第1款规定所采用的计算方式或本条第3款所述折算结果，在签字或交存其批准、接受、认可或加入文件，或按本条第2款规定作出选择时，以及计算方式或折算结果发生变动时，通知本公约保管人。

raw_Chinese: 在细胞核内，SMN蛋白位于若干个微小的（直径仅0.1~0.2μm）、与螺旋体（卡哈尔体）相连的斑点样结构上，该结构称为“双子”（螺旋体双子）。
raw_English: Within the nucleus , this protein localises to several small [ 0.1-2 .0 m diameter ] , punctate structures associated with coiled [ Cajal ] bodies named gems [ gemini of coiled bodies ] .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 虽然该结构的确切细胞学作用尚不清楚，但是SMA患者细胞中的“双子”数量明显少于致病基因携带者和正常对照者。
raw_English: Although the exact cellular function of gems remains unknown , cells from patients with spinal muscular atrophy contain substantially fewer gems than do those in gene carriers and controls without the disease .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 对于真核细胞，转录后的前体mRNA的剪接是由细胞内的剪接体完成的。
raw_English: In eukaryotic cells , the spliceosome is the cellular organelle that executes post-transcriptional pre-mRNA splicing .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 富含尿嘧啶的snRNPs(UsnRNPs)是主要的剪接体成分，其识别出外显子中高度保守的基因序列并与之相结合。
raw_English: Uridine-rich snRNPs [ U snRNPs ] , the principal components of spliceosomes , recognize highly conserved sequences and ligate exons .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SMN蛋白——与至少另外8种蛋白质构成一种具有高度稳定性的复合体结构——是UsnRNP中Smith核蛋白体正确剪接的充分且必要条件。
raw_English: SMN protein , part of a highly stable complex with at least eight other proteins , is necessary and sufficient for proper assembly of Smith class core proteins in the U snRNP .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 介导Smith蛋白组装的SMN核心区的一个点突变(E134K)，可以通过影响SMN-Smith蛋白结合域的电荷分布而致病。
raw_English: A point mutation [ E134K ] in the SMN tudor domain , the region that mediates Smith class protein assembly , can cause the disease by affecting the charge distribution in the SMN-Smith class binding site .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SnRNP的组装活性在胚胎阶段和新生儿期很高，但是在向肌细胞和神经细胞分化后活性降低。
raw_English: SnRNP assembly activity is high during embryonic and postnatal development but decreases after myogenic and neuronal differentiation .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 而此时，由多种调节细胞功能（如细胞周期等）的基因参与的转录体系高度活化。
raw_English: Transcriptional networks involving many genes that regulate cellular dynamics [ eg , cell-cycle progression ] are highly active during this time .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 如此高的RNA转录负荷可能需要大量的snRNP以满足加IRNA的需要。
raw_English: This RNA transcriptional burden might need high amounts of snRNPs to accomplish processing of RNA .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在SMA患者中，因SMN蛋白不足而导致的snRNP合成抑制可能会引起运动神经元变性。
raw_English: Inhibition of snRNP biogenesis by defective SMN protein might cause motor neuron degeneration seen in patients with spinal muscular atrophy .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: Winkler及其同事发现，在蛙类(Xenopuslaevis)和斑马鱼(Daniorerio)胚胎模型中，UsnRNP合成抑制会引起与SMA患者类似的运动神经元变性，但胚胎发育相对正常。
raw_English: Winkler and co-workers noted that impaired U snRNP biosynthesis in both frog [ Xenopus laevis ] and zebrafish [ Danio rerio ] embryonic models induced degeneration of motor neurons similar to that seen in spinal muscular atrophy despite rather normal development .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: Gabanella等也报道，与正常大鼠（Smn+/+；SMN2+/+）相比，（Smn-/-；SMN2+/+）大鼠脑和脊髓中的SMN蛋白水平仅为正常的1/8，snRNP组装活性仅为正常的1/10。
raw_English: Gabanella and others showed that Smn - \/ - ; SMN2 + \/ + mice have an eight-fold decrease in SMN protein and a ten-fold decrease in snRNP assembly activity in the brain and spinal cord compared with normal [ Smn + \/ + ; SMN2 + \/ + ] mice .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SMN蛋白在所有的体细胞内都有表达，但为何在SMA的病理过程中以脊髓运动神经元受累为主，这一点目前还不清楚。
raw_English: Although SMN protein is expressed in all somatic cells , why motor neurons of the spinal cord are specifically vulnerable in spinal muscular atrophy is puzzling .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 相关研究显示，SMN蛋白可能在神经细胞特有的某些细胞功能中发挥重要作用。
raw_English: Studies suggest that SMN protein might have an important part in certain cellular functions that are unique to motor neurons .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 研究人员发现，SMN蛋白分布于初级运动神经元的轴突和生长锥内的核糖核蛋白颗粒中，在胚胎干细胞分化而来的运动神经元中也存在。
raw_English: Investigators noted that this protein was localized in ribonucleoprotein granules in the neurites and growth cones of primary motor neurons , and in motor neurons derived from embryonic stem cells .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 有学者应用活细胞荧光标记技术，在显微镜下观察到了这些颗粒在神经元突起和生长锥中活跃的双向转运。
raw_English: Live-cell fluorescence microscopy was used to observe active bidirectional transport of these granules to neuronal processes and growth cones .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SMN蛋白还可以与hnRNPR和Q相互作用。
raw_English: SMN protein also interacts with hnRNP R and Q.
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: hnRNPR可与β-actinmRNA的3'端非编码区相互作用。
raw_English: hnRNP R interacts with the 3 untranslated region of - actin mRNA .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 低水平的SMN蛋白可使神经元轴突和生长锥内的β-actinmRNA及其表达的蛋白水平降低，说明SMN蛋白可能与含有β-actin分子的核糖核蛋白复合体的转运过程有关。
raw_English: Low concentration of SMN protein resulted in low titers of - actin mRNA and protein in axons and growth cones , suggesting that SMN protein might be involved in transportation of ribonucleoprotein complexes containing - actin .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在两种神经元培养模型中以及SMA斑马鱼模型中，β-actin不足可导致轴突的延伸和导向缺陷。
raw_English: Deficiency of - actin results in axonal outgrowth and pathfinding defects in two neuronal culture models and in a zebrafish model of spinal muscular atrophy .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 抑制蛋白是一种actin结合蛋白，通过螯合和释放actin分子单体起到调节actin蛋白动力学的作用。
raw_English: Profilin , an actin-binding protein , regulates actin dynamics through sequestration and release of actin monomers .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在神经元的轴突样结构和生长锥中，SMN蛋白与Ⅱa型抑制蛋白（神经组织中抑制蛋白的主要亚型）共存，呈清晰的颗粒样形态。
raw_English: SMN protein colocalises with profilin IIa [ the predominant isoform in neuronal tissue ] as distinct granules in neurite-like extensions and growth cones .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 突变的SMN蛋白不能与Ⅱa型抑制蛋白相互作用，游离的Ⅱa型抑制蛋白独自发挥作用，抑制轴突的生长。
raw_English: Mutant SMN protein fails to interact with profilin IIa , and knocking down profilin IIa alone inhibits neurite outgrowth .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: Setola及其同事报道，目前确定了一种新的SMN异构体（称作“轴突SMN”），其可优先从SMN1的内含子3中转录出来。
raw_English: Setola and colleagues reported the identification of a novel SMN isoform named axonal-SMN that is preferentially transcribed from SMN1 and includes intron three .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 出人意料的是，该内含子的重复性多聚腺嘌呤域对可能引起蛋白质C端结构变异的突变具有高度抗性，说明此序列对于维持轴突SMN分子的结构和（或）功能的完整性具有重要意义。
raw_English: The repetitive polyadenine tract of this intron was unexpectedly resistant to mutations , which would alter the C-terminal protein structure , suggesting that this sequence might be needed for the structure or function , or both , of axonal-SMN .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 轴突SMN蛋白在脊髓神经胶质或Rexed的IX层（运动神经元区域）以外的灰质内未被检测到。
raw_English: The axonal-SMN protein was not detected in the glia or gray matter outside Rexed 's lamina IX [ motor neuron area ] in the spinal cord .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 一些研究小组制备了本病的黑腹果蝇模型，观察到了神经和肌组织缺陷。
raw_English: Several groups have made disease models in Drosophila melanogaster that show neuronal and muscular defects .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 基于这些模型的建立，科学家推测SMN蛋白在神经肌肉接头处和骨骼肌中起一定作用。
raw_English: These models have led to postulation of roles for SMN protein at the neuromuscular junction and in skeletal muscle .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 上述资料说明，SMN蛋白可能通过促进正常的轴突转运和维持神经肌肉接头的完整性，从而保持运动神经元存活。
raw_English: These data suggest that SMN protein might sustain the survival of motor neurons by allowing normal axonal transport and maintaining the integrity of neuromuscular junctions .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 鉴于运动神经元的长轴突结构及其与骨骼肌独特的相互作用模式，较低的SMN蛋白水平可能会对运动神经元产生特异性损害。
raw_English: Low concentrations of SMN protein might be specifically detrimental to motor neurons because of the long axons and their unique interactions with skeletal muscles .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 鼠Smn基因位于第13号染色体上，与人类SMN基因一样，包含9个外显子，其开放阅读窗口与SMN1基因具有83%的同源性。
raw_English: The mouse Smn gene , located on chromosome 13 , contains nine exons like the human SMN gene and is 83 % homologous to the SMN1 open reading frame .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 自从1.4kb的转录产物被发现以来，尚未见其他选择性剪接亚型的存在。
raw_English: No alternative splicing isoform exists since only a full-length 1.4 kb transcript has been noted .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 制备鼠SMA模型相当困难，因为鼠Smn纯合子缺失（Smn-/-）可导致胚胎死亡，而杂合性Smn+/-鼠为正常表型。
raw_English: Creating a mouse with spinal muscular atrophy was challenging because homozygous deletion of murine Smn [ Smn - \/ - ] is lethal at the embryonic stage , whereas heterozygous Smn + \/ - mice are phenotypically normal .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这就要求通过新技术来建立鼠SMA模型。
raw_English: These early failures suggested that more innovative approaches were needed to establish a mouse model of the disease .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 过去7年间，科学家建立了若干种小鼠SMA模型。
raw_English: In the past 7 years , several different models of spinal muscular atrophy have been developed in mice .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 中国台湾科学家观察发现，本病患者通常具有至少一个SMN2拷贝，并建立了携带有人SMN2基因的转基因鼠（Tg鼠）模型。
raw_English: Taiwanese scientists used the observation that patients with this disease always have at least one copy of SMN2 and created a transgenic [ Tg ] mouse with human SMN2 .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 将Smn+/-鼠与Smn+/-；TgSMN2鼠杂交，从而获得了Smn-/-；TgSMN2鼠，其临床表现和组织病理学特点均与人类SMA相似。
raw_English: Smn + \/ - mice were crossed with Smn + \/ - ; TgSMN2 mice to produce Smn - \/ - ; TgSMN2 , with clinically and histopathologically similar spinal muscular atrophy to that in people .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 其他研究小组也应用类似的技术建立了模拟人类SMA的小鼠模型，其疾病严重度（包括临床症状和病理学表现）各不相同。
raw_English: Similar strategies were used by other groups to create model mice that mimicked human spinal muscular atrophy with varying severities in clinical symptoms and histopathology .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 不同实验室建立的Smn-/-；TgSMN2动物模型的表型差异很大，推测可能与模型动物本身的基因背景差异或等位基因敲除位点的不同有关，也可能与转基因片段的大小有关。
raw_English: Smn - \/ - ; TgSMN2 produced in different laboratories have varying phenotypes , presumably because of different genetic backgrounds , different allelic knockouts , or different sizes of transgene regions .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 通过纯化基因背景而对SMN2拷贝数进行标准化，有学者建立了表型稳定的Ⅲ型SMA小鼠模型。
raw_English: By purifying the genetic background to standardise the number of SMN2 copies , a mouse with type III spinal muscular atrophy with no phenotypic heterogeneity was created .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 还有学者在神经或肌肉组织中，应用loxP序列包夹Smn基因(floxed)，并在神经特异性或肌特异性启动子作用下表达Cre重组酶，从而实现组织特异性的SMN蛋白阻断。
raw_English: Tissue-specific knockdown of SMN protein has also been accomplished in neurons or muscle , by flanking Smn with loxP sequences [ floxed ] and expressing Cre recombinase under a neuronal-specific or muscle-specific promoter .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 通过同源重组，Cre重组酶表达并介导标记基因的切除。
raw_English: Expression of Cre recombinase results in efficient deletion of floxed genes by homologous recombination .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 也有学者建立了神经或肌组织的构成性SMN过表达模型。
raw_English: Constitutive overexpresssion of SMN protein has also been accomplished in neuronal and skeletal muscle tissue .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: Gavrilina等的研究显示，神经系统的过表达可以显著延长Smn-/-；SMN2+/+鼠的寿命，但在骨骼肌中过表达却无此效果。
raw_English: Gavrilina and others showed that neuronal overexpression significantly prolonged Smn - \/ - ; SMN2 + \/ + mice , but overexpression in skeletal muscle had no effect .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: Butchback及其同事建立了Smn-/-；SMN2+/+；SMN△7+/+鼠模型，其症状表现较为严重（寿命14~15d)。
raw_English: Butchback and colleagues created an Smn - \/ - ; SMN2 + \/ + ; SMN 7 + \/ + mouse whose phenotype is slightly less severe [ lifespan 14-15 days ] .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SMN基因的确定不仅推动了对SMA分子生物学发病机制的研究，而且为本病的快速敏感诊断提供了可能。
raw_English: Identification of the SMN genes not only enabled further research into the molecular pathogenesis of spinal muscular atrophy , but also allowed rapid and sensitive diagnosis .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 图4显示了应用分子遗传学手段诊断本病的方法。
raw_English: Figure 4 shows the algorithm for diagnosis of the disease by molecular genetic methods .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 疑似SMA的患者应首先接受检查以判断是否为SMN1纯合子缺失，该检查的敏感性达95%，特异性达100%。
raw_English: Patients with a clinical presentation resembling spinal muscular atrophy should be tested for homozygous deletion of the SMN1 gene , which is 95 % sensitive and about 100 % specific .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 确诊性检查方法有两种：PCR检测联合限制性内切酶消化分析法，SMN1和SMN2的PCR产物等位基因特异性分析法。
raw_English: Two diagnostic tests exist : a combined PCR with restriction enzyme digestion assay and an allelespecific PCR assay of the SMN1 and SMN2 PCR products .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 前一种方法应用了SMN1和SMN2的PCR产物对于核酸内切酶的不同敏感性。
raw_English: The first method uses differential susceptibility of the SMN1 and SMN2 PCR products to endonuclease digestion .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 而等位基因PCR分析法则利用了外显子7的核苷酸序列差异以及特异设计的PCR引物，从而定量扩增SMN1或SMN2基因。
raw_English: The allele-specific PCR assay uses the nucleotide variation in exon seven and specifically designed PCR primers to quantitatively amplify SMN1 or SMN2 .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这两种方法均可以确诊5qSMA，且后者可以定量检测SMN1基因的拷贝数。
raw_English: Both tests confirm a diagnosis of 5q spinal muscular atrophy , but the second one provides a quantitative measure of SMN1 copy number .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 当仅检测到一个SMN1基因拷贝时，就需要通过基因测序来确定是否存在SMN1基因内突变。
raw_English: In cases in which a single copy of SMN1 is detected , further investigation into SMN1 intragenic mutations by gene sequencing is warranted .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 当检测到两个SMN1基因拷贝时，则需行进一步的诊断，以确定是否存在其他的运动神经元、脑部、脊髓及神经肌肉接头病变（图4）。
raw_English: When two SMN1 copies are detected , further diagnostic studies should investigate other motor neuron , brain , spinal cord , and neuromuscular junction diseases [ figure 4 ] .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 几乎所有的SMA患者都存在相同的SMN1基因缺失，但临床表现却差异很大。
raw_English: The phenotypic heterogeneity of spinal muscular atrophy is striking considering that nearly all patients have a defect in the same SMN1 gene .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 起初，人们推测本病表型与基因组缺失的片段大小有关，然而对该不稳定的基因区域进行深入研究后发现，人类基因组内存在多个SMN2基因拷贝，其可能由基因重复和（或）碱基转换造成。
raw_English: After initial hypotheses that the disease phenotype correlates with the size of the genomic deletion , a thorough search of this unstable genetic region revealed multiple SMN2 copies in the human genome , possibly caused by gene duplication or conversion events , or both .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 对Smn-/-鼠进行研究后发现，转入人类SMN2基因可以防止胚胎早期死亡的发生，而8个人类SMN2拷贝可保证子代鼠的表型正常。
raw_English: Investigation with Smn - \/ - mice showed that adding a human SMN2 transgene could rescue pups from early embryonic death , and eight copies of human SMN2 could produce a phenotypically normal mouse .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在人类进行的其他研究也证实，具有多个SMN2基因拷贝的患者病情较轻。
raw_English: Other studies in man also showed that a higher number of SMN2 copies correlates with milder phenotypes .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 然而，对于具有相同SMN2基因拷贝数的患者，其疾病表型之间往往仍存在相当的差异。
raw_English: However , variations in phenotypes are common with any number of SMN2 copies .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 因此，目前并不推荐按照SMN2基因拷贝数来判断SMA表型。
raw_English: Therefore , prediction of the spinal muscular atrophy phenotype with SMN2 copy number is not recommended .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 有证据显示，可能还存在其他表型调控基因，如GTF2H2（BTF2P44）、SERFIA（H4F5）等。
raw_English: Some evidence suggests that other phenotype-modifier genes -- eg , GTF2H2 [ BTF2P44 ] , SERF1A [ H4F5 ] -- might exist .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 另外，有研究证实，病情较轻的患者其SMN蛋白表达水平也较高。
raw_English: Evidence also suggests that higher amount of SMN protein is observed in patients with milder form of spinal muscular atrophy .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SMN1和SMN2的高度同源性给通过PCR手段确定本病致病基因携带者带来了一定困难，这是因为在扩增SMN1片段的同时往往也扩增了SMN2片段。
raw_English: High homology between SMN1 and SMN2 complicated carrier detection with PCR methods , because amplification of an SMN1 fragment frequently amplifies SMN2 as well .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 最初，人们应用高敏感性的PCR产物光密度检测法来确定目的基因的拷贝数，从而确定携带者。
raw_English: Initial carrier detection methods used high sensitivity densitometry of PCR products to identify copy number .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 现在，人们应用实时定量PCR方法，该方法可以分别确定SMN1和SMN2基因的拷贝数。
raw_English: Present methods use quantitative real-time PCR allowing measurement of both SMN1 and SMN2 copy number separately .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 然而，SMN1拷贝数检测可能难以判断携带者的具体病情，因为正常人群中约有3.2%的个体其两个SMN1基因拷贝位于同一个染色体上而另一个染色体上没有（表示为2+0）。
raw_English: However , the SMN1 copy number test might rarely and inaccurately determine the carrier status , because about 3.2 % of the general population has both SMN1 copies on one chromosome and none on the other [ denoted 2 +0 ] .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这些人被判断为携带者，因为其染色体上缺乏一个正常的SMN1等位基因。
raw_English: These people are carriers because one of their chromosomes is missing a normal SMN1 allele .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 另外，还有1.7%的人存在难以通过上述SMN1定量分析法检测出来的基因内突变。
raw_English: Another 1.7 % have intragenic mutations that are not detectable by these methods of SMN1 dosage analysis .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: SMN1基因测序可以发现基因内突变，2+0携带者可通过荧光原位杂交及其核型分析确定。
raw_English: SMN1 gene sequencing can detect intragenic mutations , and 2 +0 carriers can be detected by karyotyping with fluorescence in-situ hybridisation .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 绒毛膜采样和羊膜腔穿刺术可高效确定胎儿的基因型。
raw_English: Chorionic villi sampling and amniocentesis can effectively find out the fetal genotype .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 此外，采用膜滤过分离上皮性肿瘤或滋养层细胞技术(ISET)，可以从母体血液中分离出循环胎儿细胞用于PCR基因分析。
raw_English: Additionally , circulating fetal cells in maternal blood can be isolated by isolation by size of epithelial tumor or trophoblastic cells [ ISET ] for PCR-based genetic analysis .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 对于不愿等待至怀孕早期才取得诊断结果的孕妇，可以通过体外受精技术，取数个卵裂球样本经培养后进行SMN1缺失检测。
raw_English: For those who do not want to wait for the decision until early pregnancy , in-vitro fertilisation allows several blastomeres to be tested for SMN1 deletion after growth in culture .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 对单个细胞进行等位基因特异性PCR分析后，即可将未受损的胚胎植入母体。
raw_English: After the allele-specific PCR assay of a single cell is done , unaffected embryos can be implanted .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 但是该方法对技术精度要求很高，只能在特定的机构开展。
raw_English: This procedure requires high technical precision and is available only at select centres .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 但是其难点在于如何在发病前确定患者。
raw_English: The challenge , however , is the identification of these patients before they are symptomatic .

raw_Chinese: 携带致病基因的父母通常无症状，而大多数SMA患儿在出生后数月内也表现正常。

raw_Chinese: 举例来说，很多植物体内的近年节律生物钟能够预感到寒冷季节的到来，此时体内的细胞会开始硬化，以应付即将来临的冬季和可能突然造访的霜冻。
raw_English: For example , as though in preparation for the coming winter , many plants seem to have an internal circannual timer that enables them to anticipate the onset of the cold season and harden their cells so as to survive a sudden frost .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 和雪靴兔类似，植物体内的这种近年节律计时系统实际上是对白天长度的一种反应。该系统依靠一个昼夜节律生物钟测量白天的长度变化。
raw_English: As in the case of the snowshoe rabbit , often this apparently circannual timing is , in reality , a response to the length of day , measured by means of a circadian clock .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 植物体内的这种生理节律要么是遗传下来的，要么就是在对外部刺激的反应过程中逐渐形成的。即便外部的刺激被人为地消除了，植物体内的这种节律依然会存在或多或少的一段时间，而且这种节律不会随植物周围的温度变化而变化。
raw_English: These internal rhythms are either inherited or learned from external stimuli , but they persist for various lengths of time after the latter are removed , and their periods do not vary with ambient temperature .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 然而，为了与外部世界的大环境保持同步，植物体内的生物钟也必须依据光线变化提供的线索进行有规律的调整和重置。
raw_English: In order to remain synchronous with the outside world , however , the internal clock has to be entrained and regularly reset by light cues .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在某些情况下，有节律的温度变化也会成为生物钟调整的外部线索，但对大部分的生物钟来说，起作用的外部线索——生理学者把这些刺激称为zeitgebere(德语，意为“给时者”——译者注)一—看起来是光线强度的变化。
raw_English: Though rhythmic temperature changes also work in some instances , the cues that serve to entrain most biological clocks these are called zeitgebers ( timegivers ) by physiologists seem to be varying levels of light intensity .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 外部的客观环境必然会对生物体内的计时系统演变发挥关键的作用，这当然没有什么奇怪的，因为我们得以维系生命的昼夜节律就根源于对昼夜更迭的体验。
raw_English: This is hardly surprising , as the origin of the diurnal rhythm of our life is the experience of the succession of day by night ; that environmental fact must have been of key importance in the evolution of the internal timing mechanism .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 然而，生物钟的调整过程并不一定是一次突然的、不连续的重置。
raw_English: The process of entrainment is not necessarily a sudden , discontinuous resetting of the clock , however .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在很多情况下，这种调整过程会在瞬间开始，然后就会逐渐地从一个旧的阶段过渡到一个新的阶段，就像我们对时钟进行调整一样，我们只是在瞬间通过外部介质慢慢地转动时钟的指针，而这并不会改变其固有的转动周期，也就是说，在完成调整的那一刻起，该时钟指针的转动既不会加快，也不会变慢。
raw_English: In many instances it is , after an instantaneous initiation , a gradual change from an old phase to a new one , like the slow turning of the hands of a clock by an external agent , without altering its intrinsic period , that is , without causing it to go faster or slower from that point on .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 令人非常惊奇的是，昼夜节律甚至会存在于最为简单的生物有机体内，比如单细胞的青绿色藻类（藻青菌），这种藻类内生有一个以24小时为周期的生物钟，能够与固氮作用和光合作用保持同步。
raw_English: Remarkably enough , circadian rhythms exist even in the simplest biological organisms , such as the single-celled blue-green algae ( cyanobacteria ) , in which an internal clock paces the 24-hour cycles of nitrogen oxation and photosynthesis .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这种生理周期能够及时地把这两种过程分离开来，而这对于藻青菌生理机能的正确发挥至关重要，因为氧气——光合作用的一种产物——的存在会对固氮作用产生干扰。
raw_English: The cycles serve to separate these two processes in time , which is crucial for their proper functioning because the presence of oxygen a product of photosynthesis interferes with nitrogen fixation .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 多边膝沟藻是一种单细胞的海生腰鞭毛虫，这种能够发光的海藻大量存在于北美洲西海岸的沿海水域中。
raw_English: The marine dino . agellate Gonyaulax polyedra is a single-celled bioluminescent alga that exists in very large quantities in coastal waters off the West Coast of North America .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 生物体的发光是一个化学过程，一个荧光素分子会在荧光素酶的催化作用下氧化，产生一个新的高能态分子，随后该高能态分子会恢复到基态，同时释放出一个光量子。
raw_English: Bioluminescence is a chemical process in which an enzyme , luciferase , oxidizes a luciferin molecule , producing a new molecule at a higher energy state , which subsequently descends to its ground state , emitting a light quantum .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 膝沟藻能够发出两种不同的光：一种是有节奏变幻的稳定而柔和的光，在接近黎明的时候达到最亮；另一种是亮度明显大很多的有节奏的闪光，在接近午夜的时候达到顶峰，不过这需要外部的诱因来引发。
raw_English: Gonyaulax exhibits two kinds of luminescence : a low-intensity steady glow that varies rhythmically , peaking near the approach of dawn , and a much brighter rhythmic flash , at its maximum near midnight , that requires an external disturbance to set it off .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 另外，膝沟藻体内还存在着其他的生理节律，其中包括一个可以在黎明时分突然阻止细胞分裂的节律，还包括一个能够使其光合能力在固定的时间暂时丧失的节律。
raw_English: In addition , Gonyaulax also has other circadian rhythms , including one which causes a sharp spike in cell division at dawn , and another spike in its photosynthetic capacity .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 但在正常的情况下，其白天的光合作用则具有非常明显的周期性，如果持续提供稳定的弱光照射膝沟藻，其所有的生理节律能够在几个星期内都保持不变。
raw_English: but under normal conditions it has a distinct diurnal periodicity , maintaining all of its rhythms for weeks when under steady , dim illumination .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 如果是在一片漆黑的情况下，膝沟藻的光合作用就会完全停止，其所有的生理节律都会瞬间丧失。不过，短暂的强烈闪光能够让膝沟藻的光合作用恢复正常，从而使其重新获得生理节律，并能保证与此前的节律同步。
raw_English: In total darkness , with its photosynthesis at a stand-still , it quickly loses all its rhythms but regains them at their previous pace when photosynthesis is restored by a short , intense flash of light .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这看起来可能有些不可思议，如此简单的生物体，仅仅有一个细胞，却能保有很多独立的昼夜节律和其他的生理节律。
raw_English: Surprising as it may seem , this simple organism , consisting of a single cell , can thus sustain many independent circadian and other rhythms .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 事实上，有证据表明单个细胞内的计时器甚至能够左C大而复杂的器官的生理周期，比如人类的心脏，而正是心脏的节律性跳动让我们人类能够在这个星球上繁衍生息。
raw_English: Indeed , it has been demonstrated that the timers contained in single cells govern even the biological periodicities of large , complicated organs such as the human heart , whose ongoing rhythm keeps us alive .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 大约40年前，洛杉肌加州大学的艾萨克˙哈拉里发明了一种方法，能够把老鼠心脏的细胞进行分离，让它们在营养培养基中独自存活。
raw_English: Some forty years ago , Isaac Harary at the University of California in Los Angeles invented a process to separate the cells of a rat 's heart and keep them alive in a nutrient medium .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 他通过显微镜对这些细胞进行观察，发现其中某些单独的细胞依然保持着原有的搏动节律，而且完全是在独自进行。
raw_English: Examining them under a microscope , he found that some of these single cells were still beating at the old rhythm , all on their own .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 最令人惊奇的或许是一些单细胞的细菌，它们每隔16个小时分裂繁殖一次，但却依然能够将与24小时的生物钟周期几乎完全相同的生理节律信息传递给后代，而且这些节律能够与其分裂繁殖的16小时周期非常协调地发挥作用。
raw_English: What is perhaps most surpris-ing is that even some single-celled bacteria that divide and multiply once every 16 hours manage to pass along identical copies of their 24-hour clocks , running and in phase , to their off-spring !
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在这些有机体内，几乎所有的基因都处于其昼夜节律系统的掌控之中。
raw_English: Almost every gene in these organisms is controlled by their circadian system .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 对于很多鸟类来说，其昼夜节律似乎是由脑部的松果体控制的，法国哲学家笛卡尔曾认为松果体是人类灵魂的居所。
raw_English: In many birds , circadian rhythms appear to be controlled by the pineal gland , which Descartes thought was the seat of the soul in humans .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这种具有感光功能的器官能够有节律地产生降黑素，这种激素可以把腺体的活动信号传递到机体的其他部位，即便是在体外的试管环境下也是如此。
raw_English: This photosensitive organ rhythmically produces the hormone melatonin , which signals the gland 's activity to other parts of the body , even in vitro .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 首先将松果腺组织置于一个光照和黑暗每隔12小时更迭一次的环境中，然后将其转移到一个具有恒定光照的环境，在接下来的几天中，松果腺组织依然会有节律地释放数量不等的降黑素。
raw_English: When cultured in an environment with 12 hours of light and 12 hours of darkness and then transferred to one with constant illumination , pineal tissue will continue emitting cyclically varying amounts of melatonin for several days .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 更有甚者，如果把松果腺组织从一种鸟移植到另一种松果腺已被切除的鸟的体内，后者不仅能够重新获得此前已经消失的昼夜节律，而且其新获取的节律与“捐赠者”的原有节律会保持同步：接受者的行为让其看起来好像生活在捐赠者的时区中。
raw_English: What is more , when pineal tissue was transplanted from one bird to another bird whose pineal gland had been removed , the new host not only regained the circadian rhythms it had previously lost , but the phase of its newly acquired rhythms was that of the donor : the host acted as if it lived in the donor 's time zone .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 即便是试管中的腺体部分，也会在一定的时间内节律性地继续产生降黑素。
raw_English: Even pieces of the gland in vitro will for some time continue to produce melatonin at a rhythmic rate .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 另一方面，对于哺乳动物来说，包括人类，绝大部分（虽然不是全部）生理节律最核心的中枢起搏点是被称为视交叉上核（SCN)的两团神经细胞体，视交叉上核位于视网膜后视交叉上部的下丘脑内。
raw_English: On the other hand , in mammals , including humans , the primary central pacemakers of most , though not all , of these rhythms are the two clusters of nerve cell bodies called the suprachiasmatic nuclei ( SCN ) , located in the hypothalamus just above the optic chiasm behind the retina .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 视交叉上核能够完全独立地产生节律，而无须任何外部的光线线索。
raw_English: The SCN are able to generate rhythms on their own , without any kind of light cues .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 举例来说，即便把新生的幼鼠置于完全黑暗的环境中，它们也会在生命的第一天展示出非常明显的昼夜节律。
raw_English: Newborn rats , for example , kept in total darkness , exhibit a distinct circadian rhythm even on their first day of life .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 然而，在正常情况下，视交叉上核会与其周围的昼夜更迭保持同步，其调整的路径即是直接来自视网膜的视觉影像。
raw_English: Under normal operations , however , the SCN are synchronized with the day-night cycle of their surroundings , the entrainment paths being visual projections directly from the retina .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 事实上，最近人们才发现眼睛里包含有直接与视交叉上核相连的特殊图像传感器，这些传感器并不用于视觉，所以即便是盲人也可以借助它们调整自己的昼夜节律。另外，下丘脑还包含有另外一个截然不同的次昼夜节律生物钟——以每小时为周期调整促卵泡激素的分泌。
raw_English: In fact , it has very recently been discovered that the eye contains special photo sensors , not used for vision , connected directly to the SCN , enabling even some people who are blind to entrain their circadian rhythm .3 In addition , the hypothalamus also contains another , distinct ultradian pacemaker that regulates the release of a follicle-stimulating hormone every hour a circhoral clock .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 目前已经发现，很多独立的昼夜节律振荡器遍布哺乳动物的全身，以用来调整其行为和生理机能在特定区域的节律。
raw_English: Many separate circadian oscillators have now been found scattered throughout the body , to regulate local rhythms in behavior and physiological functioning .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 这些计时器仅能在有限的几天时间内保持自身的节律，并需要经常性地接受来自核心生物钟视交叉上核的信号进行必要的调整。
raw_English: These timers can maintain their rhythms by themselves for only a few days and are constantly entrained by signals from the master clock , the SCN .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在生物体内发现的生物钟节律到底是来源于生命早期外部的信号刺激还是由遗传基因决定的呢？通过更为细致入微的实验，特别是针对无处不在的果蝇进行的实验，如今该问题已经有了答案。
raw_English: The question of whether the rhythms of the many kinds of biological clocks found in organisms are imprinted on them by external signals early in life or , instead , are genetically determined has been answered by detailed experiments , particularly those performed on the ubiquitous fruit fly .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 黑腹果蝇有两个互为关联的稳定节律系统，一种用来控制其活动和休息的周期，另一种用来调整其幼虫在一天中破蛹而出的时间。
raw_English: Drosophila melanogaster has two relatively stable circadian systems , one regulating its rest-activity cycle and another governing the times of day at which their young emerge from their pupae .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1979年，R.J.科诺普卡培养出了根本没有周期性节律系统的变种果蝇以及节奏周期分别为较短的19小时和较长的28小时的变种果蝇。
raw_English: In 1979 R. J. Konopka produced mutants that had no periodicity at all , others that had short periods of about 19 hours , and still others that had periods as long as 28 hours .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 通过对标准实验室果蝇（“野生型”）的一个特定基因（因此也是变种命名的依据）的变异，对三个变种加以区分。
raw_English: Each mutant differed by a single gene ( thereafter named per ) from the standard laboratory fruit fly ( the ' wild type ' ) .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 遗传学家还对粗糙脉孢菌进行了研究，该菌类产生孢子的行为是经由一种昼夜节律系统控制的。
raw_English: Geneticists also studied the fungus Neuro-spora , whose production of spores is governed by a circadian system .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 该菌类的变种呈现出不同的节律周期，如果把不同变种的细胞和野生型的细胞混合，那么混合物的节律周期会因含有突变基因的细胞核的多少相应地发生变化。
raw_English: Mutants exhibited a range of different periods ; in a mixture of cells with various mutants as well as wild types , the length of the circadian period turned out to be proportional to the percentage of nuclei with mutant genes .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 上述实验表明，一个种群的节律周期长短并不是由特定的遗传基因所决定的。
raw_English: In this case , there was no unique genetic locus that determined the length of the circadian period in a population .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 1950年，俄国化学家鲍里斯˙贝洛索夫发现了现在被称为贝洛索夫-恰鲍廷斯基反应（BZ反应）的振荡化学反应，该反应能够节律性地产生变化的振荡波，从而把不同颜色的反应产物区分开来（参见图2)。从那时起，我们就已经知道仅仅依靠化学性质就可以产生节律性的行为。
raw_English: That chemistry alone is capable of producing rhythmic behavior has been known since 1950 , when the Russian chemist Boris Belousov discovered what has come to be called the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction , which produces rhythmically changing waves that separate reaction products of different colors ( see Figure 2 ) .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 因此，就植物来说，其生物钟机制应该也具备类似的纯生物化学性质。
raw_English: In plants , the clock mechanism has to be of an analogous purely biochemical nature .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 事实上，悬浮发酵酵母细胞的能量代谢实验表明：当定态代谢受到随后添加的发酵基质干扰时，其发酵能量的产生过程——称为糖酵解——就会以几分钟为一个周期开始振荡，随后就可以在无细胞的试管环境下对糖酵解过程中不同周期的振荡进行研究，此时它们除了化学反应就再没有其他激发因素了。
raw_English: Indeed , experiments performed on the energy metabolism of yeast cells fermenting in suspension have shown that when the metabolic steady state is perturbed by the addition of a substrate , their fermenting energy production called glycolysis begins to oscillate with a period of several minutes , and these variations in glycolysis can then be studied in vitro in a cell-free preparation , with nothing at work to engender them but chemistry .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 观察到的振荡行为是工程师们所称的反馈机制的典型后果，催化糖酵解过程、将果糖-6-磷酸（F-6-P)转化为果糖二磷酸钠（FDP)的酶本身也是被FDP激活的。
raw_English: The observed oscillatory behavior is the typical consequence of what engineers call a feedback mechanism : the enzyme doing the glycolysis , converting fructose-6-phos-phate ( F-6-P ) to fructose-diphosphate ( FDP ) , is itself activated by FDP .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 因此，当糖酵解开始产生FDP时，催化酶被激活并且开始加速，原始F-6-P的浓度开始不断缩小，并因此抑制FDP的进一步产生并减缓糖酵解过程，这会持续一段较长的时间，直到消耗的F-6-P重新得以补充为止。
raw_English: Thus , when the glycolysis begins to produce FDP , it is stimulated and accelerates , diminishing the concentration of the original F-6-P , thereby inhibiting further FDP production and slowing the fermentation until , after a considerable delay , the F-6-P has been replenished by newly arriving stock .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 在合适的浓度和代谢速度下，F-6-P和FDP的浓度最终会进入一个节律性变化的过程，两者周期相同，步伐各异，此多彼少，互为消长。
raw_English: At the right concentration and metabolic flow , the levels of both F-6-P and FDP will , as a result , change rhythmically , each with the same period but out of phase , with F-6-P low when FDP is high , and vice versa .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （相对于没有时间延迟的情况下迅速进入均衡状态，上述过程中生物化学进程的放缓所造成的时间延迟对于产生节律性的变化是至关重要的。）通过在一个没有任何细胞的系统中选择适当的催化酶、物质浓度和流动速率，生物学家已经可以实现周期为24小时的代谢振荡——也就是单纯通过化学性质实现的昼夜节律。
raw_English: ( The delay caused by the slowness of the biochemical pro-cesses involved is crucial in producing the rhythmic changes in concentration rather than a quick relaxation into equilibrium , as it would without the time lag . ) Choosing appropri-ate enzymes , concentrations , and flow rates in a system without any cells , biologists have been able to achieve meta-bolic oscillations with 24-hour periods circadian rhythms by purely chemical means .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 同样的反馈机制还被用在果蝇身上产生昼夜节律，唯一不同的是F-6-P和FDP的位置被以下物质取代了：生物节律基因（pergene)产生的效率比（测量蛋白质完全性的指标。——译者注）不同的蛋白质（PERpmtehi)以及其合成的信使核糖核酸，还有其他一些蛋白质。
raw_English: A similar feedback mechanism has been found to produce the circadian rhythm in Droso-phila , only in this case the places of F-6-P and FDP are taken by the PER protein produced by the per gene and the messenger RNA it synthesizes , as well as several other pro-teins .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: （虽然机制的原理相同，但在藻青菌中产生生物钟的蛋白质和在果蝇体内产生生物钟的蛋甴质却大为不同，从这一点我们或许可以总结说：节律系统看起来不太可能是从一个唯一的共同祖先进化而来的。
raw_English: ( Though the principles of the mechanism are the same , the proteins involved in producing the biological clock in the cyanobacteria are quite different from those in Drosophila , from which we may conclude that circadian systems are unlikely to have evolved from a single common ancestor . )
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 此类反馈的结果通常被描述为一个极限环，无论反应是何时发生的，两种反应物数量的对比图最终会越来越趋向于一个相同的闭合曲线（参见图3)。
raw_English: The outcome of such feedback is often described by a limit cycle , in which the plot of the amount of one of the reagents against that of the other approaches the same closed curve more and more closely , no matter where they started out ( see Figure 3 ) .
Label: Human

raw_Chinese: 此时两种物质的浓度开始跳舞，每一个都是按照固定的节律从高往低舞动。
